import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 250010;
    static int n, k, p;
    static int[] bits = new int[MAXN];
    static long[][] x = new long[26][MAXN];
    static long[] factorial = new long[MAXN];
    static long[] invFactorial = new long[MAXN];
    static long base, result;
    static BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
    static StringTokenizer st;

    static long power(long baseVal, int exp) {
        long res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = res * baseVal % p;
            baseVal = baseVal * baseVal % p;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static long dfs(int depth, int num) {
        if (bits[num] < depth) return 0;
        if (depth == 1) return x[depth][num];
        if (x[depth][num] != 0) return x[depth][num];
        int count = 0;
        int mask = num & (num - 1);
        while (mask != 0) {
            if (bits[mask] >= depth - 1) {
                x[depth][num] += dfs(depth - 1, mask) * x[num ^ mask][num];
                if (++count == 18) {
                    count = 0;
                    x[depth][num] %= p;
                }
            }
            mask = (mask - 1) & num;
        }
        x[depth][num] %= p;
        return x[depth][num];
    }

    static long comb(int n, int m) {
        return factorial[n] * invFactorial[m] % p * invFactorial[n - m] % p;
    }

    static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        // Read input
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        p = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            bits[i] = bits[i >> 1] + (i & 1);
        }

        base = power(k, n);
        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println((long) base);
            return;
        }

        int limit = Math.min(k, bits[n]);
        factorial[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            factorial[i] = factorial[i - 1] * i % p;
        }
        invFactorial[n] = power(factorial[n], p - 2);
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
            invFactorial[i] = invFactorial[i + 1] * (i + 1) % p;
        }

        result = 0;
        for (int i = limit; i >= 1; i--) {
            result += comb(k, i) * dfs(i, n);
        }
        result = (base - result % p * factorial[n] % p + p) % p;
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
